# Code Like Him

Keep contracts explicit at system boundaries, regardless of the implementation surface.

For Rails code, keep controllers HTTP-focused and move workflow orchestration into services.

Do not turn the anti-pattern into a preference: vague commit messages are explicitly discouraged.
